origin.description: Classify each training row from the other training rows.
origin.details: The neighbor search drops the point itself. The vote is the same first-maximum rule as knn.
origin.example: leave-one-out knn.cv on the six-point two-class train, k=2, prob TRUE

translation.description: knn_cv classifies each training point from its neighbors in the same set.
translation.details: The neighbor search drops the point itself. The vote is the same first-maximum rule as knn.
translation.example: leave-one-out knn.cv on the six-point two-class train, k=2, prob TRUE
